 Search Tems reveals ‘Children of the Blood and Bone’ original soundtrack
 Buddy Iahn 
 November 12, 2026 
 R&B/Funk/Soul , World 
 Courtesy of RCA Records Burna Boy and others also appear
 Nigerian singer/songwriter/producer Tems, who is also the executive music producer of the upcoming feature film from Paramount Pictures, Children of the Blood and Bone, announces the release of “African Love Story,” the lead single for the film’s soundtrack. Both written and performed by Tems, the track is set to be released next Friday, November 20th, via RCA Records.
 Alongside the single announcement, the soundtrack guest features have also been revealed, which includes Ayra Starr, Burna Boy, Fireboy DML and more. Burna Boy also serves as the film’s executive music consultant.
 In the epic fantasy world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule. Directed by Gina Prince-Bythewood, Children of the Blood and Bone features a stellar cast including Thuso Mbedu, Damson Idris, Amandla Stenberg, Tosin Cole, featuring Academy Award nominee Cynthia Erivo, Lashana Lynch, Zackary Momoh, Richard Mofe-Damijo, Academy Award nominee Chiwetel Ejiofor, Academy Award winner Regina King, with Idris Elba and Academy Award winner Viola Davis. Children of the Blood and Bone is only in theaters, Dolby Cinema, Premium Large Format, and IMAX on January 15th.
 A new trailer featuring snippets from Tems’ upcoming single is available now.
